Paragraph: Mindful of the words of noble-souled Sugreeva, Hanuma took his flight from Mt. Rishyamuka to where the Raghavas are.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Hanuman is dispatched on a diplomatic mission by Sugreeva to investigate and approach the two unknown princes seen on the mountain.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuman acts promptly and obediently on instructions received, demonstrating loyal, purposeful action.
Outcome/Resolution: Hanuman sets out toward Rama and Lakshmana to begin the mission.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Karma Yoga (action performed as duty without hesitation)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Hanuman's prompt departure reflects Karma Yoga - selfless, duty-bound action undertaken on behalf of another.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Illustrates goal-directed behavior and role-clarity, where a clear directive reduces ambiguity and enables confident action.
